subject: perf(vt): batch text under open hyperlinks
result: Batch eligible text under open hyperlinks with bounded cell-map admission, per-cell references, identity/display overrides and correct row/page transitions. Specialize the private UTF-8 event path while retaining stale-resource and scalar-fallback checks.
validation: 247 VT library and 102 integration tests; 132 fresh Rust-runner native comparisons across 44 cases; 87 shared checks across 29 inputs; 22 corpus cases across both engines and both 8,192-record dense reflow checks; strict Clippy. Final 29-case/261-record matrix: short-link feed time fell 9.1–22.8%, full-link time fell 65.3–84.9%, linked-wide time fell about 86%, and linked-mixed time fell 74.4–75.5%. Largest median control cost is linked emoji +1.70%; ordinary/repaint costs stay at or below +0.90%. Comparable output, page accounting and Rust-owned storage are unchanged.
